selection.name: Kingfisher
selection.role: C04 — Provisional sole scanner, pinned to v2.9.1, for blocking credentials in staged commits and auditing Git history. No second scanner is justified by the inspected evidence.

basis.shows: Meets both required jobs: repository scans include Git history, and --staged scans the staged changes. Findings produce nonzero exit codes, including 200 for findings and 205 for validated findings. Structured output and a shell CLI provide a usable agent interface; applicability to Claude Code and Codex is an inference from their ability to invoke CLIs.

Upstream supplies local-binary, automatic-install and Docker hooks. The local hook invokes the built-in staged scan and propagates failure, providing commit protection without writing a scanner or hook implementation.

Tests cover hook installation, preservation and chaining of existing hooks, uninstall restoration, global installation and pre-commit framework invocation. These establish integration coverage, not detection accuracy or latency.
The upstream suite includes a Git-history scanning smoke test.
The Linux x64 test job completed successfully on 2026-10-02 for default-branch commit f177f957dd4e1a6d709e7191a07a66d8c90062bc.
The macOS arm64 test job completed successfully on 2026-10-02 for the same commit.

Kingfisher's published comparison reports lower runtime than TruffleHog and Gitleaks on all nine repositories tested. Examples, in that order: croc 2.64/10.36/3.10 seconds; Linux 205.19/597.51/548.96 seconds. Kingfisher and TruffleHog each reported six validated or verified findings on GitLab. The host was macOS arm64, 16 CPU cores and 48 GB RAM. This supports a bounded throughput preference, not superior recall, false-positive rate or WSL2 pre-commit latency.

Latest stable release v2.9.1 was published 2026-10-02, inside the 90-day window. Release assets include Linux x64 and macOS arm64 packages. Linux-under-WSL2 compatibility is inferred from the Linux distribution and Ubuntu CI; no GPU is required for this layer.
Latest default-branch commit was 2026-10-01, inside the 90-day window.
Repository is not archived. License is Apache-2.0, reported as information without affecting the ranking.
The GitHub API reported this issue closed on 2026-10-02; the latest three issue records also showed October activity and closures, providing evidence of active issue handling.

not_selected.name: Betterleaks
not_selected.reason: Strong close alternative: [v1.9.0 released 2026-09-29](https://github.com/betterleaks/betterleaks/releases/tag/v1.9.0), [default-branch commit 2026-09-30](https://github.com/betterleaks/betterleaks/commit/c4c0ffda3a14), successful [Ubuntu CI](https://github.com/betterleaks/betterleaks/actions/runs/36763193768/job/110050688823), native Linux/macOS arm64 assets and [staged hooks](https://github.com/betterleaks/betterleaks/blob/v1.9.0/.pre-commit-hooks.yaml); the inspected evidence does not establish a current accuracy or latency advantage for its BPE filtering, and developing v2 documentation was not treated as a released capability.

not_selected.name: ggshield
not_selected.reason: Fits commit prevention and has documented Claude Code/Codex hooks, Linux/macOS arm64 packages and recent activity—[v1.55.0 on 2026-09-24](https://github.com/GitGuardian/ggshield/releases/tag/v1.55.0), [head commit 2026-10-01](https://github.com/GitGuardian/ggshield/commit/841a768aa325)—but its [README](https://github.com/GitGuardian/ggshield/blob/main/README.md) delegates detection to an authenticated GitGuardian API, adding service and setup dependencies without a demonstrated target-host advantage; a paid-service exclusion is not justified.

not_selected.name: TruffleHog
not_selected.reason: Strong history scanner with [documented pre-commit integration](https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/blob/v3.97.9/PreCommit.md), live verification, Linux/macOS arm64 binaries, [passing tests](https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/actions/runs/36923757136/job/110575881289), [release 2026-09-24](https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/releases/tag/v3.97.9) and [head commit 2026-10-01](https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/commit/e28360875917); verification already exists in the selected scanner, and the inspected comparisons do not demonstrate additional true positives that require a second scanner.

not_selected.name: CredSweeper
not_selected.reason: ML filtering, [Git scanning](https://github.com/Samsung/CredSweeper/blob/main/docs/source/guide.rst) and [pre-commit installation](https://github.com/Samsung/CredSweeper/blob/main/docs/source/install.rst) fit both jobs, with [passing development tests](https://github.com/Samsung/CredSweeper/actions/runs/36682133093/job/109779698084), [v1.18.5 released 2026-09-21](https://github.com/Samsung/CredSweeper/releases/tag/v1.18.5) and [head commit 2026-09-30](https://github.com/Samsung/CredSweeper/commit/368863a62f44); its [published CredData accuracy table](https://github.com/Samsung/CredData/blob/main/README.md#benchmark-result) dates to April 2022 and combines training and test data, so it does not establish present-day superiority or a needed incremental detection job.

not_selected.name: Gitleaks
not_selected.reason: Excellent full-fit fallback with [native staged hooks](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/blob/v8.30.1/.pre-commit-hooks.yaml), history scanning, Linux/macOS arm64 binaries and [passing Ubuntu tests](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/actions/runs/29939776129/job/88990408501); its [2026-07-22 default-branch commit](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/commit/b58d3f102cf3) passes the currency criterion, although [v8.30.1 was released 2026-03-21](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/tag/v8.30.1); the available throughput comparison favors Kingfisher, while current recall and commit latency remain unresolved.

not_selected.name: Rusty Hog
not_selected.reason: Its [README](https://github.com/newrelic/rusty-hog/blob/master/README.md) documents Git scanning, Linux binaries, cargo build --release and cargo test, but the [latest release is v1.0.11 from 2021-09-20](https://github.com/newrelic/rusty-hog/releases/tag/v1.0.11) and the latest issue activity inspected was January 2025, giving weaker release/support evidence for a new host; the [2026-08-03 default-branch commit](https://github.com/newrelic/rusty-hog/commit/9da595ad204f) means it is not stale under the frozen definition.

not_selected.name: Titus
not_selected.reason: Supports [full-history scanning](https://github.com/praetorian-inc/titus/blob/v1.2.10/docs/CLI.md) and Linux/macOS arm64 binaries, with [v1.2.10 released 2026-09-28](https://github.com/praetorian-inc/titus/releases/tag/v1.2.10) and [head commit 2026-09-27](https://github.com/praetorian-inc/titus/commit/510c4076c81c); inspected workflows provide a less direct commit-blocking installation path, and its browser/Burp capabilities do not supply a distinct required job; [unit tests passed](https://github.com/praetorian-inc/titus/actions/runs/36344369695/job/108690552536), while [lint failed](https://github.com/praetorian-inc/titus/actions/runs/36344369695/job/108690552576).

not_selected.name: Secretlint
not_selected.reason: Good pluggable commit prevention with Linux/macOS arm64 binaries, [v13.0.6 released 2026-09-25](https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/releases/tag/v13.0.6), [head commit 2026-10-02](https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/commit/a18c351b7886) and [passing cross-platform tests](https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/actions/runs/36956638701); its [documented workflows](https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/blob/master/README.md) center on project files and changed-file linting, giving weaker history-audit fit, and its [benchmark workflow](https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/blob/v13.0.6/.github/workflows/benchmark.yml) does not establish comparative detection accuracy.

layers.deciding_comparison: Run Kingfisher v2.9.1, Betterleaks v1.9.0, Gitleaks v8.30.1, CredSweeper v1.18.5 and TruffleHog v3.97.9 on the specified WSL2 x86_64 host against one held-out seeded corpus. Measure credential-type precision and recall, false positives, recovery from deleted files and historical commits, correct blocking with partial staging and initial commits, and cold/warm p50/p95 pre-commit latency. Record exact versions, configurations and concurrency. Compare static commit protection separately from optional live verification so expired or unverifiable credentials still count as leaks. Measure each possible second scanner's additional true positives and false positives after the first scanner; install a second only if that delta supplies a distinct needed job. The present single-scanner preference rests on documented fit, platform CI, maintenance and reported throughput, not a demonstrated overall detection winner.
evidence_gaps: The packet contains no comparison on record. Public evidence inspected does not provide a current, common-corpus comparison covering all leading candidates' detection accuracy and pre-commit latency.

Kingfisher's runtime table uses macOS arm64 rather than WSL2 and does not identify runtime-test versions, complete invocation details, repetitions or uncertainty. Its separately versioned binary-size comparison must not be used to assign versions to the runtime results.
CredData's published accuracy table is explicitly dated April 2022 and combines training and test data. It cannot decide the current Kingfisher/Betterleaks/CredSweeper ranking.

WSL2 execution and agent sessions were not tested. Kingfisher has verified Linux x64 and macOS arm64 release assets and successful CI; applicability to WSL2 and shell-based Claude Code/Codex use is inferred. Dedicated client integration was verified for ggshield from upstream documentation, without installing it.

macOS arm64 release assets were verified for Betterleaks, ggshield, TruffleHog, Kingfisher, Gitleaks, Titus and Secretlint. CredSweeper's macOS CI is documented, but its arm64 dependencies were not separately verified; Rusty Hog's macOS release architecture remains unverified.

None of the nine repositories is archived, and all have a default-branch commit within the 90-day window beginning 2026-07-04. Old releases alone therefore do not justify stale exclusions for Gitleaks or Rusty Hog. CredSweeper's latest inspected issue update was April 2026 despite recent commits and releases.

ggshield's default-head check rollup reported FAILURE while the first 30 returned contexts were successful; the failing context was not identified within the API budget. Rusty Hog's returned head checks were CodeQL-related, so a current functional-test pass was not established.

The requested ctx_fetch_and_index batch was blocked by the environment's approval policy. Upstream README and documentation contents were retrieved through the GitHub API, indexed with ctx_index and read with ctx_search. The requested page-fetch method could not be completed. Three attempted web-search queries failed; 30 GitHub API calls were used, including one rejected GraphQL query that was corrected.
